sentence: Randomly pairs everyone in the chat into one gift-giving loop, so each person privately sees only who they buy for and nobody gets themselves.
use_when: A group wants to draw names for a secret santa or gift swap
Each person should privately see who they are buying for
You want to track who has looked at their draw
A group needs a fair random assignment with no self-picks
dont_use_when: Picking one winner or one random person from the group
Splitting people into teams or groups
Collecting votes or choosing between options
Tracking a gift list, budget, or wishlist

blanks: Saturday the 6th at Felix's · $15 max · thrift store or Goodwill
